name: takeoff-ui
author: Turkish Technology Frontend Infrastructure Team < takeoffui@thy.com >

scripts.build: turbo run build --filter=!./apps/react-app --filter=!./apps/vue-app --filter=!./docs && cd docs && pnpm run generate-docs && pnpm run generate-llms-txt && pnpm run build && cd .. && pnpm run format
scripts.build:docs: turbo run build --filter=@takeoff-ui/core --filter=@takeoff-ui/react --filter=@takeoff-ui/tailwind && cd docs && pnpm run generate-docs && pnpm run generate-llms-txt && pnpm run build && cd .. && pnpm run format
scripts.dev:vue: turbo run build --filter=@takeoff-ui/core --filter=@takeoff-ui/vue && cd apps/vue-app && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:react: turbo run build --filter=@takeoff-ui/core --filter=@takeoff-ui/react && cd apps/react-app && pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:ng: turbo run build --filter=@takeoff-ui/core --filter=@takeoff-ui/angular && cd packages/angular && pnpm run start
scripts.dev:docs: turbo run build --filter=@takeoff-ui/core --filter=@takeoff-ui/react --filter=@takeoff-ui/tailwind && cd docs && pnpm run start
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rimraf dist node_modules .stencil www .angular .next .output .turbo build .docusaurus && rimraf node_modules .turbo .pnpm-store pnpm-lock.yaml
scripts.publish: pnpm run build && pnpm publish --filter=@takeoff-ui/core --filter=@takeoff-ui/react --filter=@takeoff-ui/vue --filter=@takeoff-ui/angular --filter=@takeoff-ui/tailwind --access public --no-git-checks
